conditions.name: Narcolepsy

ratingSchedule.note: Schedule of ratings, neurological conditions and convulsive disorders; diagnostic code 8108 covers narcolepsy and directs evaluation as petit mal epilepsy.

reviewNotes: Narcolepsy is kept in the neurological catalog despite the Wave 4 sleep grouping because the current rating authority is 38 CFR 4.124a, not the respiratory sleep-apnea schedule.
